images.title: Sharing runs over matches played
images.purpose: Show each batter's total shared equally over the matches actually played, so the mean is a level bar height and the missed match is not counted.
images.composition: Two rows, one per batter, each a short row of level bars on its own baseline with the calculation to its right; white space between rows.
exact_structure: Top row labelled Shubman: exactly 5 equal teal (#0072B2) bars, each 22 units tall, standing on a grey (#6B7280) baseline.
To the right of the top row: 110 ÷ 5 = 22.
Bottom row labelled Yashasvi: exactly 4 equal amber (#E69F00) bars, each 24 units tall, plus a 5th slot drawn only as an empty grey dashed outline with the small label did not play.
To the right of the bottom row: 96 ÷ 4 = 24.
A reddish purple (#CC79A7) dashed level line across the top of each row of bars; the amber bars are visibly a little taller than the teal bars (24 against 22 on the same scale).
Arithmetic check for the reviewer only, NOT drawn in the frame: 23 + 7 + 10 + 52 + 18 = 110 and 26 + 53 + 2 + 15 = 96.
rejection: the dashed empty slot filled in or given a bar
Yashasvi's bars drawn shorter than Shubman's
a count other than 5 teal bars and 4 amber bars
images.takeaway: The mean shares the total equally over the values actually recorded, so it compares groups of different sizes fairly.
images.description: Five level teal bars of 22 for Shubman beside 110 ÷ 5 = 22, and four level amber bars of 24 with an empty dashed slot marked did not play beside 96 ÷ 4 = 24.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video for this concept.
images.teaching_notes: Point out that the empty slot is left out of the division, then compare the two levels.

image_decisions.why: Level bars show the mean as an equal share and make clear why the missed match is not counted.
